name: Charlotte Adigéry & Bolis Pupul
label: DEEWEE
lede: Charlotte Adigéry and Bolis Pupul knew each other from around Ghent for years before Soulwax's Dewaele brothers put them in a room together. A week later they had an EP's worth of songs, and three records on they had an album about microaggressions you can dance to.

eras.title: Two Ghent kids on separate tracks
eras.text: Before they were a duo, Pupul was in a synthpop band with his sister and Adigéry was studying music in Hasselt. They knew each other from Ghent, nothing more.

years.h: Humo's Rock Rally gets a synthpop band called Hong Kong Dong
years.p: Boris Zeebroek runs the group with his sister and brother-in-law, and they enter Belgium's best-known young-band contest. He will later record as [[Bolis Pupul|52f78c75-9f2f-4353-a368-ac35e96ca25a]].
years.xp:
Zeebroek is the son of the Belgian cartoonist Kamagurka and Yu Wei Wun, who was born in Hong Kong and moved to Belgium at seven. According to Wikipedia, she died in a car accident in June 2008, and the band's momentum faded afterward.

The stage name is family shorthand. Wikipedia says "Bolis" is how his maternal grandmother said Boris, and "Pupul" was a sound his father made to get him to sleep.

years.h: The Rock Rally band finally gets an album out
years.p: Hong Kong Dong's debut arrives four years after the contest. Pupul's working life will soon move to Soulwax's studio.

eras.title: A blind date, then two EPs
eras.text: A film soundtrack put both of them in the same studio as the Dewaele brothers of Soulwax, and DEEWEE became the home for everything that followed. The first records went out under Adigéry's name alone.

years.src: The Line of Best Fit · DIY · NME interview
years.h: The Dewaele brothers fix a writer's block with a blind date
years.p: Soulwax's [[David Dewaele|b4209bc6-ad50-4f97-aec1-d162f222018f]] and [[Stephen Dewaele|39b125d7-b8dd-47bc-8339-0e5e2b711390]] score Felix Van Groeningen's film Belgica, with Adigéry singing on "The Best Thing". Pupul is already on their label.
years.xp:
Adigéry was stuck at DEEWEE, surrounded by, in her words, geniuses, when the Dewaeles told her to get in a room with Pupul. They knew each other from Ghent, as she told The Line of Best Fit, but "didn't really know each other."

Pupul calls them "professional friendship soulmates." DIY reports they wrote an EP's worth of material inside a week.

years.h: The self-titled EP carries Adigéry's name and nobody else's
years.p: Sung in English, French and Creole and made with Pupul, it went out on DEEWEE credited to her alone.
years.xp: DIY reports that for Topical Dancer they insisted on equal billing. Adigéry said of the earlier setup: "People saw me as a singer, the diva, and Bolis as the producer."

years.src: The Line of Best Fit · Wikipedia: Charlotte Adigéry
years.h: Zandoli, mixed by the Dewaeles, ends up in an HBO trailer
years.p: The Dewaeles co-produced and mixed the EP. "Paténipat" plays in the trailer for HBO's The New Pope.
years.xp: With Pupul producing, the EP was a practical move. Adigéry told The Line of Best Fit they "decided to do some live gigs and we needed more songs."

years.cap: Adigéry at a 3voor12 live session, Best Kept Secret festival, June 4, 2019
years.h: UK radio picks up "High Lights", and London and New York follow
years.p: Adigéry also toured with Neneh Cherry and made NME's 2019 Essential New Artists list.

eras.title: A time capsule you can dance to
eras.text: After Zandoli, Soulwax told them to make a full album. Adigéry was heavily pregnant for the cover and the videos, and the record landed on year-end lists on both sides of the Atlantic.

years.cap: Adigéry on stage with Pupul at the keyboards, Wide Awake Festival, London, May 25, 2024
years.src: Wikipedia: Topical Dancer · The Line of Best Fit
years.h: Topical Dancer lands at No. 22 on Pitchfork's 2022 list
years.p: Pitchfork's review score was 8.2. DEEWEE released it on March 4, 2022, and it peaked at No. 2 on the Ultratop Flanders chart.
years.xp:
Co-written and co-produced by Soulwax, it runs 13 tracks across English, French, Dutch and Creole. Wikipedia lists Metacritic at 85 from six reviews, and The Observer called it a banging fusion of funk, house and techno.

The concept, Adigéry told The Line of Best Fit, was a giant egg as a time capsule of 2021, to be opened in 50 years. Paste later placed the album at No. 232 on its list of the 250 greatest albums of the 21st century so far (October 2025).

years.big: “We don't want to stay bitter.” Charlotte Adigéry
years.src: DIY · The Line of Best Fit
years.h: Colonial leftovers, misogyny and pile-ons, set to house
years.p: Adigéry says humor keeps the anger from lingering, and the album uses it on purpose. "Blenda" is about being asked where she is really from.
years.xp:
DIY says "Blenda" comes from a question Adigéry has heard all her life in Belgium. "Esperanto" takes both sides of the language-policing argument at once, and the closer "Thank You" answers every condescending remark from her career in one go.

She told The Line of Best Fit humor is "a spoonful of sugar that makes the medicine go down."

years.cap: Adigéry at Film Fest Gent, October 12, 2024
years.src: Wikipedia: Topical Dancer · The Line of Best Fit
years.h: Her mother, Christiane, sings on "Ich Mwen"
years.p: A duet on womanhood and motherhood, made while Adigéry was pregnant. She took her newborn son on the press run, The Line of Best Fit reports.

years.h: "Thank You" answers every condescending remark at once
years.p: FLOOD called the closer a club hit about unwanted opinions. The official video is below.
years.xp: DIY reports it is Adigéry's reply to the mansplaining and misogynistic comments she has taken through her career. She said: "I hope the people who told me those things hear the song."

eras.title: Festival stages, then a solo letter
eras.text: The live show catches up with the record, and Pupul steps out on his own for a DEEWEE album about his mother.

years.h: Libera Awards nominate Topical Dancer for Best Electronic Record
years.p: A Belgian record lands on the American independent-music awards' 2023 shortlist, a year after its release.

years.cap: Adigéry and Pupul on stage, Wide Awake Festival, London, May 25, 2024
years.p: The duo play Glastonbury on June 25, 2023, per setlist.fm. A performance of "Mantra" from the set is on video.

years.h: Best Kept Secret, the whole set on film
years.p: A full set from the festival in 2023 shows how the record plays live.

years.cap: Pupul at the synths, ARTE Concert, Ground Control, Paris, October 20, 2024
years.h: Pupul writes to his mother and it turns into an album
years.p: He wrote Letter to Yu to Yu Wei Wun after a 2018 trip to Hong Kong, on the street where she was born. Pitchfork gave it 8.
years.xp:
According to Wikipedia, he shared the letter and demos with Stephen and David Dewaele, who pushed him to make a full album at their Ghent studio. Resident Advisor's Marshall Gu described Detroit techno and Kraftwerk-style synth pop with Hong Kong field recordings.

It peaked at No. 9 on the Ultratop Flanders chart.
